observation.command:
cd /workspace && source /etc/profile.d/rvm-fnm.sh 2>/dev/null
echo "== versions =="; ruby -v; node -v; psql --version
echo "== bundle check =="; bundle check
echo "== db tables =="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -U root -h localhost -d consul_development -tAc "select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public';"
echo "== seed counts =="; for t in users administrators proposals debates polls projekts settings; do echo -n "$t="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -U root -h localhost -d consul_development -tAc "select count(*) from $t;"; done
